blocks.html: Three-inch (76 mm) and four-inch (102 mm) decking shall have a maximum moisture content of 19 percent when machined and installed. Decking shall be machined with a double tongue-and-groove pattern. Decking pieces shall be interconnected and nailed to the supports.
